title: Hanuma apprises of the discovery of Seetha
introduction: Coming back to Madhuvana as instructed by Sugreeva, and craving forgiveness of Angada, Dadhimukha submits to him that he along with the other monkeys is urgently required by Sugreeva. Angada and other monkeys including Hanuma spring forward into the air towards Kishkindha. Even before the arrival of those monkeys, Sugreeva explains to Rama the valid reasons for concluding that Seetha has since been found. Angada, Hanuma and other, monkeys approach Sugreeva. Then, Hanuma apprises Rama of the discovery of Seetha. Hearing the news, Rama and Lakshmana were thrilled with joy and looked on Hanuma with a high esteem.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे चतुःषष्टितमः सर्गः
Thus completes 64th Chapter of Sundara Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
सुग्रीवेण एवम् उक्तः तु हृष्टो दधि मुखः कपिः |
राघवम् लक्ष्मणम् चैव सुग्रीवम् च अभ्यवादयत्
verses.iast:
sugrīveṇa evam uktaḥ tu hṛṣṭo dadhi mukhaḥ kapiḥ |
rāghavam lakṣmaṇam caiva sugrīvam ca abhyavādayat
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Sugreeva, Dadhimukha the monkey was pleased and offered his salutation with reverence to Rama, Lakshmana

glosses.meaning: and offered his salutation with reverence

verses.devanagari:
स प्रणम्य च सुग्रीवम् राघवौ च महाबलौ |
वानरैः सहितैः शूरैः दिवम् एव उत्पपात ह
verses.iast:
sa praṇamya ca sugrīvam rāghavau ca mahābalau |
vānaraiḥ sahitaiḥ śūraiḥ divam eva utpapāta ha
verses.translation: After offering salutation to Sugreeva and to the mighty Rama and Lakshmana, that Dadhimukha accompanied by his valiant monkeys, sprang into the air.

glosses.meaning: and to the mighty Rama and Lakshmana

verses.devanagari:
स प्रविष्टो मधु वनम् ददर्श हरि यूथपान् |
विमदान् उद्धतान् सर्वान् मेहमानान् मधु उदकम्
verses.iast:
sa praviṣṭo madhu vanam dadarśa hari yūthapān |
vimadān uddhatān sarvān mehamānān madhu udakam
verses.translation: That Dadhimukha, after entering Madhuvana, saw all the chiefs of monkeys, who were free from their intoxication, having passed off the honey and who were inwardly excited.

verses.devanagari:
स तान् उपागमत् वीरो बद्ध्वा कर पुट अञ्जलिम् |
उवाच वचनम् श्लक्ष्णम् इदम् हृष्टवत् अन्गदम्
verses.iast:
sa tān upāgamat vīro baddhvā kara puṭa añjalim |
uvāca vacanam ślakṣṇam idam hṛṣṭavat angadam
verses.translation: With his hands joined together for salutation, that valiant Dadhimukha approached them and cheerfully spoke the following gentle words to Angada.

glosses.meaning: with his hands joined for salutation

verses.devanagari:
सौम्य रोषो न कर्तव्यो यत् एभिः अभिवारितः |
अज्ञानात् रक्षिभिः क्रोधात् भवन्तः प्रतिषेधिताः
verses.iast:
saumya roṣo na kartavyo yat ebhiḥ abhivāritaḥ |
ajñānāt rakṣibhiḥ krodhāt bhavantaḥ pratiṣedhitāḥ
verses.translation: "O gentle sir! Due to their ignorance, these guards in anger obstructed you to enter the grove. No resentment should be harboured by you about this obstruction."

verses.devanagari:
युव राजः त्वम् ईशः च वनस्य अस्य महाबल |
मौर्ख्यात् पूर्वम् कृतो दोषः तत् भवान् क्षन्तुम् अर्हति
verses.iast:
yuva rājaḥ tvam īśaḥ ca vanasya asya mahābala |
maurkhyāt pūrvam kṛto doṣaḥ tat bhavān kṣantum arhati
verses.translation: "O exceedingly strong Angada! You are the prince and also the master of this grove. We have done a mistake

verses.devanagari:
आख्यातम् हि मया गत्वा पितृव्यस्य तव अनघ |
इह उपयानम् सर्वेषाम् एतेषाम् वन चारिणाम्
verses.iast:
ākhyātam hi mayā gatvā pitṛvyasya tava anagha |
iha upayānam sarveṣām eteṣām vana cāriṇām
verses.translation: "O faultless Angada! After going there, I indeed informed your uncle about the arrival of all these monkeys here."

verses.devanagari:
स त्वत् आगमनम् श्रुत्वा सह एभिः हरि यूथपैः |
प्रहृष्टो न तु रुष्टो असौ वनम् श्रुत्वा प्रधर्षितम्
verses.iast:
sa tvat āgamanam śrutvā saha ebhiḥ hari yūthapaiḥ |
prahṛṣṭo na tu ruṣṭo asau vanam śrutvā pradharṣitam
verses.translation: "Hearing your arrival along with these leaders of monkeys, your uncle was exceedingly pleased. Even after hearing of Madhuvana having been attacked, he did not develop any anger."

glosses.meaning: along with these leaders of monkeys

verses.devanagari:
प्रहृष्टो माम् पितृव्यः ते सुग्रीवो वानर ईश्वरः |
शीघ्रम् प्रेषय सर्वान् तान् इति ह उवाच पार्थिवः
verses.iast:
prahṛṣṭo mām pitṛvyaḥ te sugrīvo vānara īśvaraḥ |
śīghram preṣaya sarvān tān iti ha uvāca pārthivaḥ
verses.translation: "Sugreeva, your uncle, the lord of monkeys and the king was pleased and told me, 'send all the monkeys here'."

verses.devanagari:
श्रुत्वा दधि मुखस्य एतत् वचनम् श्लक्ष्णम् अन्गदः |
अब्रवीत् तान् हरि श्रेष्ठो वाक्यम् वाक्य विशारदः
verses.iast:
śrutvā dadhi mukhasya etat vacanam ślakṣṇam angadaḥ |
abravīt tān hari śreṣṭho vākyam vākya viśāradaḥ
verses.translation: Hearing these smooth words of Dadhimukha, the eloquent Angada, the foremost among the monkeys, spoke to those monkeys as follows:

verses.devanagari:
शन्के श्रुतो अयम् वृत्त अन्तो रामेण हरि यूथपाः |
तत् क्षमम् न इह नः स्थातुम् कृते कार्ये परम् तपाः
verses.iast:
śanke śruto ayam vṛtta anto rāmeṇa hari yūthapāḥ |
tat kṣamam na iha naḥ sthātum kṛte kārye param tapāḥ
verses.translation: "O the foremost of monkeys, the tormentators of enemies! I assume that Rama might have heard the news (of our arrival). Hence, it is not proper for us to remain here any longer, now that our work has been accomplished."

glosses.meaning: when the act has been accomplished.

verses.devanagari:
पीत्वा मधु यथा कामम् विश्रान्ता वन चारिणः |
किम् शेषम् गमनम् तत्र सुग्रीवो यत्र मे गुरुः
verses.iast:
pītvā madhu yathā kāmam viśrāntā vana cāriṇaḥ |
kim śeṣam gamanam tatra sugrīvo yatra me guruḥ
verses.translation: "The monkeys are taking, rest, after drinking the honey to their heart's content. What is there remaining, except to go to the place where Sugreeva my uncle is there?"

verses.devanagari:
सर्वे यथा माम् वक्ष्यन्ति समेत्य हरि यूथपाः |
तथा अस्मि कर्ता कर्तव्ये भवद्भिः परवान् अहम्
verses.iast:
sarve yathā mām vakṣyanti sametya hari yūthapāḥ |
tathā asmi kartā kartavye bhavadbhiḥ paravān aham
verses.translation: "I shall do whatever all the leaders of monkeys together tell me. I am obedient to you, in the matter of what ought to be done."

glosses.meaning: in what ought to be done.

verses.devanagari:
न आज्ञापयितुम् ईशो अहम् युव राजो अस्मि यदि अपि |
अयुक्तम् कृत कर्माणो यूयम् धर्षयितुम् मया
verses.iast:
na ājñāpayitum īśo aham yuva rājo asmi yadi api |
ayuktam kṛta karmāṇo yūyam dharṣayitum mayā
verses.translation: "I am not the master to command you, eventhough I am the crown prince. It is not befitting for me to play the lord over you, who have accomplished the task."

glosses.meaning: even though I am a prince

verses.devanagari:
ब्रुवतः च अन्गदः च एवम् श्रुत्वा वचनम् अव्ययम् |
प्रहृष्ट मनसो वाक्यम् इदम् ऊचुः वन ओकसः
verses.iast:
bruvataḥ ca angadaḥ ca evam śrutvā vacanam avyayam |
prahṛṣṭa manaso vākyam idam ūcuḥ vana okasaḥ
verses.translation: Hearing the indeclinable words spoken thus by Angada, the monkeys with their pleased minds, spoke to him (as follows:

verses.devanagari:
एवम् वक्ष्यति को राजन् प्रभुः सन् वानर ऋषभ |
ऐश्वर्य मद मत्तो हि सर्वो अहम् इति मन्यते
verses.iast:
evam vakṣyati ko rājan prabhuḥ san vānara ṛṣabha |
aiśvarya mada matto hi sarvo aham iti manyate
verses.translation: "O prince, the foremost of monkeys! Who would speak like this, while he is the lord? Every one indeed thinks one's supremacy with an excited arrogance and says 'I, I'."

verses.devanagari:
तव च इदम् सुसदृशम् वाक्यम् न अन्यस्य कस्यचित् |
सम्नतिः हि तव आख्याति भविष्यत् शुभ भाग्यताम्
verses.iast:
tava ca idam susadṛśam vākyam na anyasya kasyacit |
samnatiḥ hi tava ākhyāti bhaviṣyat śubha bhāgyatām
verses.translation: "It is so worthy of you alone that you have spoken such words. None else can utter like this. Your humility itself is telling of your future suitableness for prosperity."

glosses.meaning: of your future suitableness for prosperity.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वे वयम् अपि प्राप्ताः तत्र गन्तुम् कृत क्षणाः |
स यत्र हरि वीराणाम् सुग्रीवः पतिः अव्ययः
verses.iast:
sarve vayam api prāptāḥ tatra gantum kṛta kṣaṇāḥ |
sa yatra hari vīrāṇām sugrīvaḥ patiḥ avyayaḥ
verses.translation: "All of us, who reached here, are waiting for the right moment to go to that place where Sugreeva, the imperishable king of the heroic monkeys, is."

glosses.meaning: are waiting for the right moment
the imperishable king of the heroic monkeys

verses.devanagari:
त्वया हि अनुक्तैः हरिभिः न एव शक्यम् पदात् पदम् |
क्वचित् गन्तुम् हरि श्रेष्ठ ब्रूमः सत्यम् इदम् तु ते
verses.iast:
tvayā hi anuktaiḥ haribhiḥ na eva śakyam padāt padam |
kvacit gantum hari śreṣṭha brūmaḥ satyam idam tu te
verses.translation: "O the excellent of monkeys! Without your command, it is not possible for the monkeys anywhere, even a step forward. We are speaking this truth to you."

glosses.meaning: to go even a step forward

verses.devanagari:
एवम् तु वदताम् तेषाम् अन्गदः प्रत्यभाषत |
बाढम् गच्छाम इति उक्त्वा उत्पपात मही तलात्
verses.iast:
evam tu vadatām teṣām angadaḥ pratyabhāṣata |
bāḍham gacchāma iti uktvā utpapāta mahī talāt
verses.translation: While they were thus speaking; Angada replied, "Let us go." The mighty monkeys then sprang into the air.

verses.devanagari:
उत्पतन्तम् अनूत्पेतुः सर्वे ते हरि यूथपाः |
कृत्वा आकाशम् निराकाशम् यज्ञ उत्क्षिप्ता इव अनलाः
verses.iast:
utpatantam anūtpetuḥ sarve te hari yūthapāḥ |
kṛtvā ākāśam nirākāśam yajña utkṣiptā iva analāḥ
verses.translation: All those leaders of monkey-troops, like stones shot from a catapult, making the space space-less, followed Angada, who was springing forward.

verses.devanagari:
ते अम्बरम् सहसा उत्पत्य वेगवन्तः प्लवम्गमाः |
विनदन्तो महानादम् घना वात ईरिता यथा
verses.iast:
te ambaram sahasā utpatya vegavantaḥ plavamgamāḥ |
vinadanto mahānādam ghanā vāta īritā yathā
verses.translation: Those monkeys with speed, sounding forth a loud noise, sprang into the sky, like clouds driven by the wind.

verses.devanagari:
अन्गदे हि अननुप्राप्ते सुग्रीवो वानर अधिपः |
उवाच शोक उपहतम् रामम् कमल लोचनम्
verses.iast:
angade hi ananuprāpte sugrīvo vānara adhipaḥ |
uvāca śoka upahatam rāmam kamala locanam
verses.translation: Even before Angada landed there, Sugreeva, the king of monkeys spoke to the louts-eyed Rama, who was afflicted with grief (as follows):

verses.devanagari:
समाश्वसिहि भद्रम् ते दृष्टा देवी न संशयः |
न आगन्तुम् इह शक्यम् तैः अतीते समये हि नः
verses.iast:
samāśvasihi bhadram te dṛṣṭā devī na saṃśayaḥ |
na āgantum iha śakyam taiḥ atīte samaye hi naḥ
verses.translation: "Be pacified! Happiness to you! The princess has been seen. There is not doubt. When the time earlier fixed by us exceeds beyond limit, it is not possible for them to come here."

glosses.meaning: when the time fixed by us goes beyond limit

verses.devanagari:
न मत् सकाशम् आगच्छेत् कृत्ये हि विनिपातिते |
युव राजो महाबाहुः प्लवताम् प्रवरो अन्गदः
verses.iast:
na mat sakāśam āgacchet kṛtye hi vinipātite |
yuva rājo mahābāhuḥ plavatām pravaro angadaḥ
verses.translation: "Angada, the long-armed prince and the most excellent of monkeys does not make his appearance before my vicinity, if the work is ruined."

verses.devanagari:
यदि अपि अकृत कृत्यानाम् ईदृशः स्यात् उपक्रमः |
भवेत् तु दीन वदनो भ्रान्त विप्लुत मानसः
verses.iast:
yadi api akṛta kṛtyānām īdṛśaḥ syāt upakramaḥ |
bhavet tu dīna vadano bhrānta vipluta mānasaḥ
verses.translation: "Even if such an exploit may be possible by these monkeys who have not been able to accomplish their work, Angada would have worn a sad face and felt perplexed and scattered in mind."

glosses.meaning: would have worn a sad face
and felt perplexed and scattered in mind.

verses.devanagari:
पितृ पैतामहम् च एतत् पूर्वकैः अभिरक्षितम् |
न मे मधु वनम् हन्यात् अहृष्टः प्लवग ईश्वरः
कौसल्या सुप्रजा राम समाश्वसिहि सुव्रत |
verses.iast:
pitṛ paitāmaham ca etat pūrvakaiḥ abhirakṣitam |
na me madhu vanam hanyāt ahṛṣṭaḥ plavaga īśvaraḥ
kausalyā suprajā rāma samāśvasihi suvrata |
verses.translation: "If Angada the lord f the monkeys is not rejoiced, he would not have damaged my madhuvana, which belongs to my father and grandfather as well as protected by my forbears. Get consoled well, O virtuous Rama, the splendid son of Kausalya!"

glosses.meaning: if Angada the lord of monkeys is not rejoiced
which belongs to my father and grandfather

verses.devanagari:
दृष्टा देवी न संदेहो न च अन्येन हनूमता
न हि अन्यः कर्मणः हेतुः साधने तत् विधो भवेत् |
verses.iast:
dṛṣṭā devī na saṃdeho na ca anyena hanūmatā
na hi anyaḥ karmaṇaḥ hetuḥ sādhane tat vidho bhavet |
verses.translation: "Seetha was seen. There is no doubt. None other than Hanuma must have seen Seetha. There is indeed none other than Hanuma, who is the executor."

verses.devanagari:
हनूमति हि सिद्धिः च मतिः च मति सत्तम
व्यवसायः च वीर्यम् च सूर्ये तेज इव ध्रुवम् |
verses.iast:
hanūmati hi siddhiḥ ca matiḥ ca mati sattama
vyavasāyaḥ ca vīryam ca sūrye teja iva dhruvam |
verses.translation: "O Rama, having a very good understanding! In Hanuma, qualities like capacity to accomplish any object, intelligence, strenuous effort and vigour are unchangeable, like a splendour in the sun."

verses.devanagari:
जाम्बवान् यत्र नेता स्यात् अन्गदः च बल ईश्वरः
हनूमान् च अपि अधिष्ठाता न तस्य गतिः अन्यथा |
verses.iast:
jāmbavān yatra netā syāt angadaḥ ca bala īśvaraḥ
hanūmān ca api adhiṣṭhātā na tasya gatiḥ anyathā |
verses.translation: "Where Jambavan is a leader; Angada as the commander of troops and moreover Hanuma as the administer, the progress of that work cannot be as otherwise."

verses.devanagari:
मा भूः चिन्ता समायुक्तः सम्प्रति अमित विक्रम
ततः किल किला शब्दम् शुश्राव आसन्नम् अम्बरे |
हनूमत् कर्म दृप्तानाम् नर्दताम् कानन ओकसाम्
किष्किन्धाम् उपयातानाम् सिद्धिम् कथयताम् इव |
verses.iast:
mā bhūḥ cintā samāyuktaḥ samprati amita vikrama
tataḥ kila kilā śabdam śuśrāva āsannam ambare |
hanūmat karma dṛptānām nardatām kānana okasām
kiṣkindhām upayātānām siddhim kathayatām iva |
verses.translation: "O Rama, of unlimited prowess! Do not encounter troubled thoughts now!" Meanwhile, when the monkeys, who are proud of Hanuma's performance and who are making noise as though they are proclaiming about the accomplishment of their act are approaching Kishkindha Sugreeva heard certain sounds expressing joy, in the vicinity of the sky."

glosses.meaning: O Rama of unlimited prowess! maabhuuH chintaa samaayuktaH = do not encounter troubled thoughts
who are proud of Hanuma's performance

verses.devanagari:
ततः श्रुत्वा निनादम् तम् कपीनाम् कपि सत्तमः
आयत अन्चित लान्गूलः सो अभवद्त् हृष्ट मानसः |
verses.iast:
tataḥ śrutvā ninādam tam kapīnām kapi sattamaḥ
āyata ancita lāngūlaḥ so abhavadt hṛṣṭa mānasaḥ |
verses.translation: Then, hearing that clamour of the monkeys, Sugreeva the chief of the monkeys became rejoiced at heart, duly stretching and curling up his tail (in joy).

glosses.meaning: duly stretching and curling up his tail.

verses.devanagari:
आजग्मुः ते अपि हरयो राम दर्शन कान्क्षिणः
अन्गदम् पुरतः कृत्वा हनूमन्तम् च वानरम् |
verses.iast:
ājagmuḥ te api harayo rāma darśana kānkṣiṇaḥ
angadam purataḥ kṛtvā hanūmantam ca vānaram |
verses.translation: Keeping Angada and Hanuma in front of them, those monkeys too arrived with their eagerness to see Rama.

glosses.meaning: with their eagerness or see Rama.

verses.devanagari:
ते अन्गद प्रमुखा वीराः प्रहृष्टाः च मुदा अन्विताः
निपेतुः हरि राजस्य समीपे राघवस्य च |
verses.iast:
te angada pramukhā vīrāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ ca mudā anvitāḥ
nipetuḥ hari rājasya samīpe rāghavasya ca |
verses.translation: Those heroes, having Angada as their chief, exceedingly pleased as they were and filled with joy, landed at the vicinity of Sugreeva and Rama.

verses.devanagari:
हनूमान् च महाबहुः प्रणम्य शिरसा ततः
नियताम् अक्षताम् देवीम् राघवाय न्यवेदयत् |
verses.iast:
hanūmān ca mahābahuḥ praṇamya śirasā tataḥ
niyatām akṣatām devīm rāghavāya nyavedayat |
verses.translation: Thereafter, the mighty armed Hanuma, offering his salutation in bending his head low, informed Rama that Seetha the princess is constant in devotion to Rama and sound in body.

glosses.meaning: is constant in devotion to her husband

verses.devanagari:
दृष्टा देवीति हनुमद्वदनादमृतोपमम्
आकर्ण्य वचनम् रामो हर्षमाप सलक्ष्मणः |
verses.iast:
dṛṣṭā devīti hanumadvadanādamṛtopamam
ākarṇya vacanam rāmo harṣamāpa salakṣmaṇaḥ |
verses.translation: Hearing the nectar-like words, saying "Seetha was found" from the mouth of Hanuma, Rama and Lakshmana felt happy.

verses.devanagari:
निश्चित अर्थम् ततः तस्मिन् सुग्रीवम् पवन आत्मजे
लक्ष्मणः प्रीतिमान् प्रीतम् बहु मानात् अवैक्षत |
verses.iast:
niścita artham tataḥ tasmin sugrīvam pavana ātmaje
lakṣmaṇaḥ prītimān prītam bahu mānāt avaikṣata |
verses.translation: Thereupon, Lakshmana with love looked with reverence on the joyful Sugreeva, who earlier decidedly apprised about the aforesaid Hanuma, having accomplished the task.

verses.devanagari:
प्रीत्या च रममाणो अथ राघवः पर वीरहा
बहु मानेन महता हनूमन्तम् अवैक्षत |
verses.iast:
prītyā ca ramamāṇo atha rāghavaḥ para vīrahā
bahu mānena mahatā hanūmantam avaikṣata |
verses.translation: Rama, the annihilator of hostile heroes, who obtained a great joy, looked on Hanuma with a high esteem.
